csv_project_name: DB for Vertical Conveyance Project Phases 2 - 4
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Orange is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from interested and qualified firms ( Respondents ) to provide design and construction services for the Vertical Conveyance Project Phases 2 - 4 ( Project ). Respondents shall be firms formally organized as design-build entities, general contractors and design firms that have associated specifically for this Project, consortia of firms or any other interested parties. Associations may be as joint ventures or Prime/Subcontractor relationships. Selected Respondents will be invited to participate in the next step of this solicitation process, the Request for Proposals ( RFP ).

title: Design-Build for Vertical Conveyance Project Phases 2-4
short_description: Design-build services for major vertical conveyance upgrades in Santa Ana, California.
project_scope: The County of Orange seeks qualifications for the Vertical Conveyance Project Phases 2-4 in Santa Ana. The tender is for a design-build delivery and includes design and construction services. The source indicates a total construction cost of 68.0 million and references transportation-related infrastructure with vertical conveyance systems; no further technical characteristics such as number of units, building areas, or spans are stated.
services: Design-build services including architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, landscape architecture, geotechnical engineering, rehabilitation and refurbishment, traffic design engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Project concerns vertical conveyance systems rather than bridges, long-span roofs, or special lightweight structures.
- Strong focus on multidisciplinary design-build delivery, but not on sbp core structural typologies.
- Includes structural engineering, yet the main scope appears building systems and transportation facility upgrades.
- Also includes disciplines outside sbp focus such as MEP-heavy services and project management.
- Therefore only low strategic relevance for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. Only total construction cost of 68.0 million is provided; no reliable sbp-specific fee can be derived from the source.
references_qualifications: Bidders must submit Statements of Qualifications and be formally organized as design-build entities, general contractors with design firms associated for this project, consortia, joint ventures, or prime/subcontractor teams. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
award_criteria: Two-stage process: SOQ/RFQ followed by invitation to selected respondents to submit proposals in the RFP stage. Specific award criteria and weighting are not stated in the source.
